record.original_question: Fix k >= 2 and an even integer m. Among all non-bipartite graphs with m edges that avoid every odd cycle C_3, C_5, ..., C_{2k+1}, which graph has the largest spectral radius?

evidence.quote: Problem 5 (Li, Feng and Peng [19], 2024). For even m, what is the extremal graph attaining the maximum spectral radius over all non-bipartite {C3, C5, . . . , C2k+1}-free graphs with m edges?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a finite simple graph and let $\lambda(G)$ denote its spectral radius, i.e. the largest eigenvalue of its adjacency matrix. For an integer $k\ge 2$, a graph $G$ is said to be $\{C_3,C_5,\ldots,C_{2k+1}\}$-free if it contains no cycle of odd length $3,5,\ldots,2k+1$ as a subgraph. A graph is non-bipartite if it contains at least one odd cycle (necessarily of length $\ge 2k+3$ under the above forbidden-cycle hypothesis).

Fix an integer $k\ge 2$ and an even positive integer $m$. Let $\mathcal{G}_{k,m}$ denote the family of all non-bipartite, $\{C_3,C_5,\ldots,C_{2k+1}\}$-free graphs with exactly $m$ edges. Determine
$$\max\{\lambda(G) : G\in\mathcal{G}_{k,m}\}$$
and characterize all extremal graphs that attain this maximum.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent (2024–2025) work has resolved related cases (e.g., the triangle-free non-bipartite case with even size, and strong spectral stabilities for $C_{2k+1}$-free graphs), but the general problem for arbitrary $k\ge 2$ and even $m$ — identifying the extremal non-bipartite $\{C_3,\dots,C_{2k+1}\}$-free graph maximizing the spectral radius — does not appear to be fully resolved in the literature found. It is posed as an open problem in current surveys.

status_evidence.title: Strong spectral stabilities for C_{2k+1}-free graphs
status_evidence.snippet: First spectral extremal result studying the maximum spectral radius of a C_{2k+1}-free graph with high chromatic number.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work addresses related stability results but the even-size extremal characterization remains stated as open.

status_evidence.title: A Spectral Extremal Problem on Non-Bipartite Triangle-Free Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Characterizes three kinds of spectral extremal graphs over all triangle-free non-bipartite graphs with even size.
status_evidence.claim: The k=1 (triangle-free) even-size case has been resolved, motivating the general open problem.

status_evidence.title: Spectral extremal problems for non-bipartite graphs without odd cycles
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates the maximum spectral radius of non-bipartite graphs without some short odd cycles.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress is reported but a complete answer for all k>=2 and even m has not been verified.
